|game_text=Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star". Your [[Death Star]] sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force Drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. [[Attack Run]] is canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-05-Rebel_Sacrifice-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The current text is [[Rebel Sacrifice (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), which has the original words again.
* '''Original''' ([[Rebel Sacrifice]]): Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet, official text as of 16 December 2011 (slip 05)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"), page 4, slip 19 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star." Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-05-Rebel_Sacrifice.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; no slip number, the Virtual Block 7 set mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 7 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1274_19">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock7Type (Virtual Block 7 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star". Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force Drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' Two changes: the full stop after “Death Star” moves outside the closing quote mark (“Death Star.” becomes “Death Star”.), and “a Force drain” is written “a Force Drain”, with a capital D. The list's missing space after the written-out [Light Side] icon (“[Light Side],and”) is icon notation, not a change. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rebel Sacrifice (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rebelsacrifice-pre.gif]]): “Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star." Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the image prints the original words of [[Rebel Sacrifice]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 7 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rebel Sacrifice (Errata 3)]]): Master List (Light Side p. 27), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=27 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star." Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-19-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' nothing against PC-E2; the Master List also prints the original words of [[Rebel Sacrifice]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 7 set mark.
